settings.heading: Bayou Blanks vs S&S Activewear
settings.answer: Bayou Blanks is the no-hoops alternative to S&S Activewear. S&S is a true wholesale distributor — you register, log in to see prices, and file a resale certificate before your first order. Bayou is open to anyone: the per-unit price is on the page, no account, buy a single pack at a flat $4.25/unit.

settings.text: S&S Activewear is a wholesale distributor built for businesses — you must register and log in just to see pricing; Bayou shows the per-unit price to anyone, no account.
S&S requires a resale/tax certificate on file before it ships your first order; Bayou has no paperwork — buy a single pack and go.
S&S free shipping starts at $200; Bayou sells by the pack with no business-sized order required.
Same price on every size at Bayou — a 4XL is the same $4.25/unit as a small — while the brands S&S carries upcharge for 2XL and up.
Honest trade-off: S&S's true wholesale case pricing can beat Bayou per unit if you're buying full cases of specific brands, and its 100+ brand catalog is far deeper.
Where Bayou wins: anyone can buy, no account or license, small orders welcome, and flat extended-size pricing.

settings.question: Do you need an account to buy from S&S Activewear?
settings.answer: Yes. You have to register and log in just to see S&S pricing. Business customers get wholesale pricing, personal users see retail, and S&S requires a signed resale/tax certificate on file before it ships your first order. Bayou requires none of that — the price is on the page and anyone can buy a single pack.

settings.question: Is Bayou Blanks cheaper than S&S Activewear?
settings.answer: It depends on how you buy. S&S's true wholesale case pricing on brand basics can go below $4.25 per unit if you're ordering full cases as a business. Bayou wins on small and mid orders, on flat pricing across every size, and on access — no account, no resale certificate, no $200 shipping threshold.

settings.question: Can I buy from S&S without a business?
settings.answer: You can register as a personal user, but you'll see retail pricing, and wholesale requires business details and a resale certificate. Bayou is one price for everyone with no business required — useful if you're a side hustle, a team, or just want blanks without the paperwork.

settings.question: Does Bayou cost more for plus sizes like 2XL–5XL?
settings.answer: No. Bayou prices every size the same — a 4XL is the same $4.25/unit as a small. The brand blanks S&S carries add a size upcharge starting at 2XL, so extended sizes is where Bayou's gap is widest.

settings.question: What's the catch with Bayou's liquidation blanks?
settings.answer: Selection. Bayou stocks around 85 curated overstock styles, not S&S's 100+ brand catalog. If you need a specific brand and color in bulk, S&S's range and case pricing are deeper; if you want blanks with no account and a flat per-unit price, Bayou wins.

settings.question: S&S Activewear or Bayou — which should I use?
settings.answer: Use S&S if you're an established decorator or reseller buying cases of specific brands and you already have a business account and resale certificate. Use Bayou when you want to buy blanks now with no account or license — especially small-to-mid orders and extended or plus sizes.
